config.notes: Open Polytechnic of New Zealand (distance/online only). Pages are qualification pages on www.openpolytechnic.ac.nz/qualifications-and-courses/<code>-<slug>/ with a summary strip: "Academic level: Level N", "Programme credits", "Delivery method: Online study", "Programme cost: $N NZ Domestic" (whole-programme DOMESTIC estimate, often $0 under zero-fees; stored pages show the domestic view only, no international fee anywhere) and "Time limit: Maximum completion time" (a completion limit, not a duration). No IELTS on course pages: English is central (https://www.openpolytechnic.ac.nz/study-with-us/how-to-apply/english-language-requirements/). Most programmes have rolling course starts (fortnightly, every month) on the central page https://www.openpolytechnic.ac.nz/study-with-us/how-to-apply/course-start-end-and-withdrawal-dates/ ; only the cohort teaching programmes print intakes on the page as "enrol in the <Month YYYY> intake", which the intakes pattern reads. Fee is deliberately not read. Not a student-visa provider: programmes are distance study, generally not open to international students on a student visa.
